purpose: Admission requirements for a seismic point-process null before the seismic cohort can receive bootstrap-based false-alarm calibration.

current_pipeline_policy.detector_execution: Allowed for descriptive diagnostics only; never suppressed by G1.
current_pipeline_policy.reason: A scalar stationarity screen and generic block bootstrap do not model magnitude completeness, temporal clustering, aftershock triggering, or catalog-scale heterogeneity.

mandatory_admission_gates.requirement: Validate raw USGS features, exact event identity, UTC range, spatial membership, magnitude threshold, duplicate conflicts, raw snapshots and SHA-256.
Estimate Mc(t, region) with uncertainty by spatial-temporal strata; demonstrate stability/sensitivity and exclude intervals below defensible completeness.
Retain magType and magSource. Calibrate frequency-magnitude behavior within compatible scales; never pool incompatible scales solely because values are numeric.
Fit and validate a space-time ETAS-family conditional-intensity model on the completeness-filtered, non-declustered catalog; preserve background-rate variation and event-triggered clustering.
Compare against a time-varying inhomogeneous Poisson background-rate model as a simpler benchmark; homogeneous Poisson is not the final seismic null.
Only for a separate declustered-background track, compare declared declustering methods and parameter uncertainty; keep this distinct from the full-catalog ETAS track.

Use fitted-model simulations, predictive diagnostics, held-out catalog periods, event-count distributions and spatial-temporal residual tests to estimate conditional alarm probabilities with uncertainty.
Predeclare injected event-cluster and rate-change scenarios; measure detection power, false alarms and detection delay separately.

forbidden_claims_until_all_gates_pass: Earthquake prediction or operational warning capability
Seismic structural-break validation based only on inter-event intervals
Magnitude completeness inferred from the query minimum magnitude
note: This readiness record points to the canonical seismic null model contract. No ETAS/Hawkes fit, Mc(t,region) estimate, or seismic null calibration has yet been validated.
